subject: Quick check — SOC 2 packet + next steps from last week
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Porter <alex.porter@summitai.com>, Tara Singh <tara.singh@summitai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 15:08:00 -0400
Subject: Post-call recap + SOC 2 packet (links and next steps)

Hi Alex/Tara —

Thanks again for the call earlier — appreciate you walking through SummitAI's latency and compliance constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- What we heard: model inference needs for the recommendation surface (200–400 qps expected), hard latency SLOs at 95th = 120ms, and data isolation for PII-containing logs.
- What Redwood will provide: dedicated pool sizing guidance, SOC 2 evidence packet for security/compliance, and a suggested mutual action plan (MAP) for a pilot.

Action items:
1) I'm attaching our SOC 2 packet and a short security datasheet for your compliance team to review. [attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Packet_v2.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB)] [attachment: redwood-security-datasheet.pdf (PDF, 0.4MB)]
2) If there are any immediate blockers on the compliance side, please flag them so we can pull in our security SME.
3) If procurement is the gating item, share your target approval date and preferred contract template.

Proposed next step: 30-minute follow-up with your compliance lead + our security engineer next week to go over the SOC 2 packet and pilot scope. I blocked time on Wed/Thu — let me know what works, or feel free to suggest a slot.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | (415) 555-0193

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference

Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + SOC 2 packet (links and next steps)

Thanks, Soojin — received the packet.

I'll loop in Tara from procurement and our compliance manager (Sara Cole) to take a first pass. We should be able to get an initial read by early next week. For the pilot timeline, we're targeting an internal decision by end of July but procurement may push that out.

If you have any short FAQ materials or a one-pager that summarizes the SOC2 artifacts included, send them over and I'll share with the team.

—Alex
Alex Porter
Head of Platform Engineering | SummitAI
alex.porter@summitai.com

Hi Alex/Tara —

Wanted to bump this thread in case the SOC 2 packet got buried. Two quick things: 1) are there any blockers from compliance or procurement we can help unblock? 2) would a short Q&A with our security engineer be helpful to accelerate review?

We can do a focused 20–25 minute session to walk the compliance team through the evidence map and provide clarifications on control ownership and retention. Marcus (copied) can join to cover pilot sizing and SLA options if that's useful.

If getting a calendar invite is easiest, here are two windows I'm proposing next week:
- Tue 20 Jul, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 21 Jul, 14:00–14:30 PT

Alternatively, if procurement is the blocker, let me know an internal target date and I can align our legal team to review T&Cs earlier.

Thanks,
Soojin

Following up from Soojin — wanted to offer an executive lane if this helps move things along.
